crossRefs.note: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?”…
Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You didn’t find them breaking in, but it is…
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them…
Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out there; and though they be hidden from…

translations.web: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.
translations.bsb: “Son of man,” He told me, “dig through the wall.” So I dug through the wall and discovered a doorway.
translations.kjv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
translations.asv: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold, a door.
